name: Shing Bhujiya - Nimbu Chatka
ingredients_raw: Peanut (70%), chickpea flour (13%), edible vegetable oil (contains one or more of the followings: palmolein, rice bran, corn, cottonseed), corn flour, black gram flour, seasoning (edible common salt, spices & condiments (chilli, cumin, black pepper, carom seed), dehydrated vegetable powder (garlic, onion, lemon (0.3%)), maltodextrin, hydrolyzed vegetable protein (soya), acidity regulator (INS 330), yeast extract, flavour enhancer (INS 627, INS 631), anticaking agent (INS 551), flavour (natural & nature identical flavouring substances)).
